properties.title: Flood Advisory issued October 25 at 6:07PM MDT until October 25 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM

rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Otero County in south central New Mexico...

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

thunderstorms. This  will cause arroyo and small stream flooding.
Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Timberon, Sacramento, Hay Canyon and Bug Scuttle Ranch.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.

dangers of flooding.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued October 25 at 6:06PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 606 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
San Jon, or 24 miles east of Tucumcari, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
San Jon and Bard.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 352 and 372.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Motorists can expect brief but sudden changes in visibility and
ponding of water on roadways as storms move through the area.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 1:27PM MST until October 26 at 9:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding along the Little Colorado River from earlier
excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...The Little Colorado River from Birdsprings to Leupp.

* WHEN...Until 900 AM MST /1000 AM MDT/ Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is occurring near
Birdsprings. Deadly flooding over low-water crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 111 PM MST /211 PM MDT/, water levels have fallen below action
stage at Winslow and will continue to fall this afternoon.
However, downstream impacts will continue near Birdsprings
through Monday morning.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 1:00pm MST /2:00pm MDT/ the stage was 16.94 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: Water levels have fallen below action stage and will
continue to fall through this afternoon.
Impacts:
At 17.0 feet: Downstream, the approaches to the bridge over the
river on Navajo Route 71 near Birdsprings will flood, and Leupp
will be within 3 feet of flooding problems. The river will crest
at Navajo Route 71 approximately 18 hours after the river crests
at Winslow.

- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.
